mesh_determinism.note: wing_vol_smoke.cgns raw file bytes differ between identical reruns (sha256 mismatch), but every HDF5 dataset in the CGNS file (coordinates, connectivity, BC arrays -- 29/29 datasets) is bit-identical (np.array_equal). The difference is non-semantic HDF5/CGNS container metadata (e.g. a creation timestamp/library string), not the mesh. The march itself is deterministic; sha256-only determinism checks on CGNS files will show false positives for nondeterminism and should compare dataset contents, not raw bytes.

solver_determinism.reruns_separated_by: independent aeris cfd run invocations, same machine/env, different wall-clock time
